answers.how: At 1.0 s, the spacecraft is about 341 px long. A quadratic fit to its center positions gives acceleration ≈232 px/s², so the scale is 4/232 m/px.
The spacecraft is about 171 px wide. Using the acceleration-derived scale of 4/232 m/px gives 2.95 m.
The fitted motion gives speed ≈116 px/s at 0.5 s. Multiplying by 4/232 m/px gives 2 m/s.
The fitted motion gives speed ≈232 px/s at 1.0 s. Multiplying by 4/232 m/px gives 4 m/s.
